_source: Pre-first-run fallback only: the president pipeline recomputes these from the stored presidential population every run (president_scorer.compute_president_reference) and writes /data/president_reference.json, which takes precedence. Values are the 2026-07 measurements previously hand-typed into president_scorer.py: approval and trend over the 15 presidents with UCSB approval pages (Truman onward), election margin over 42 elected presidencies (UCSB, rescaled onto the popular-margin scale), C-SPAN 2021 Historians Survey totals over 44 rated presidents (Cleveland once).
